description: Journalism explores how news is gathered and shared: press freedom and ethics, comparing news coverage across media, writing hard news and features, covering a public event, and journalism careers.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The 2026 update added an online-article option and a new careers requirement.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Press freedom and ethics
requirements.summary: Freedom of the press, the First Amendment, fact versus opinion, and libel and slander.

requirements.title: Exploring the media
requirements.summary: One option: print and online journalism, or radio and television, including comparing coverage and visiting a newsroom or station.

requirements.title: Writing
requirements.summary: Hard news versus features, the five Ws and H, and a writing option such as an article or interview.

requirements.title: Covering an event
requirements.summary: Attending a public event and producing articles, a broadcast-style package or a photo story.

requirements.title: Careers
requirements.summary: Journalism careers and researching one of them.
